note: Labels for tables that print the percentage of revenue as a plain number, with no % sign (D-061), written by reading the pages with tools/pg.py BEFORE the code that reads them. Same rules and cut-off as pilot.json. These three filings were already seen as 'unresolved' (D-054, D-055), so this is development data for the new feature, not a held-out set. Each row was also checked by arithmetic: percent is about amount divided by the filing's revenue from operations (Runwal: 1,211.96 / 6.74% gives about 17,980 million in every row; Nityas: 295.19 / 14.55% gives about 2,029 million). Runwal prints the percentage column BEFORE the amount column; Nityas prints amount first.
